title: 短信和聊天记录
goal: 根据多轮回应确定指代，并理解省略、缩写和口语表达。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 确定每条消息回应的对象和指代
理解省略、缩写和口语表达

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、计分、自适应

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 题目说明和官方样题（挖空规则是对照样题和答案看出来的）

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Reading Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：三类题的说明和需要的三项基本功

cards.title: 结构
rows: 先确认发言者，再找所回应的问题。
Ari: Who has the key? Bo: I do.
回应可能指向较早的问题。
Ari: Who has the key? Cy: The gate is shut. Bo: I have it.
按名词的单复数及动作确定对象。
The labels are ready. Please attach them.
Ari: Tuesday? Bo: No, Wednesday. Ari: Agreed.
回应可能只接受其中一部分请求。
Ari: Can you bring cups and plates? Bo: Cups, yes; no plates.

cards.title: 常用表达：缩写一
rows: 告知一件事，供对方参考。
FYI, the side gate is open.
Ari: Could you lock up? Bo: np.

cards.title: 常用表达：缩写二
rows: IDK which drawer has the tape.
TBH, the label is hard to read.
IMO, the shorter version is clearer.

cards.title: 常用表达：省略与语气
rows: 按上下文补出主语和助动词。
Running late. = I am running late.
按上下文补出 do you 等成分。
Need the red folder? = Do you need the red folder?
Ari: Meet at six? Bo: Works for me.
请人帮忙，不是请人递东西。
Can someone give me a hand carrying this?
The date is still up in the air.
看评价的话和后面的理由。
That is a relief. I thought the file was lost.
先道谢，再用 but 引出拒绝。
Thanks for asking, but I cannot join today.

body.box:
Suri: Can someone bring the folding stand?
Noel: Where are we meeting?
Tao: At the loading door.
Suri: The stand is in the cupboard.
Noel: Found it. I can carry it.
Tao: thx. That gives me a hand with setup.

What does Noel offer to carry?
1. The cupboard
2. The folding stand
3. The loading door
4. The setup instructions

body.p: Found it 省略了主语 I，回应的是 Suri 最先提到的支架。carry it 的 it 指 folding stand，即第二项。
中间插入了见面地点的问答：At the loading door 回应 Where are we meeting。这组问答不影响后面 it 的指代。thx 表示感谢，give me a hand 在这里指帮忙布置。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: it refers to the loading door.
能搬的是支架，不是离 it 最近的名词。
Tao offers to carry the stand.
give me a hand means pass me an object.
后面的 setup 说明是帮忙布置。
Noel agrees to complete all setup work.
Noel 只说了 I can carry it。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Lena: Are the name cards ready?
Owen: Still cutting them.
Lena: Fine, I will arrange the chairs.

options: The chairs that Lena is going to arrange
The scissors Owen is using to cut
The name cards that Owen is cutting
The cards Lena has already set out
items.why: 依据是 Are the name cards ready?，them 回指复数的 name cards，即第三项。椅子在 them 之后才提到。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Kit: Need the charger?
Jo: Yes, mine is at home.
Kit: np, I will leave it beside the monitor.

options: Kit agrees to help with the request.
Kit cannot find the missing charger.
Kit asks Jo to return home first.
Kit refuses to leave the charger.
items.why: Jo 对 Need the charger? 回答 Yes。np 即 no problem，表示 Kit 答应把充电器留下，即第一项。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Nia: Who can water the balcony herbs?
Omar: Are the scissors there?
Pia: I can do the watering after work.
Nia: Thanks, Pia.

items.stem: Which message does Pia respond to?
options: Omar's question about the scissors
Nia's final message thanking Pia
Omar's question about the balcony herbs
Nia's request about the balcony herbs
items.why: 依据是 I can do the watering after work，watering 对应 Nia 的 water the balcony herbs，即第四项。第三项把提问的人换成了 Omar。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Ren: Is the extra rehearsal confirmed?
Tess: Still up in the air. Waiting for the room booking.

items.stem: What does Tess mean about the rehearsal?
options: It has moved to another room.
Its plans are not yet settled.
Its room booking is confirmed.
It has definitely been canceled.
items.why: 依据是 Still up in the air 和 Waiting for the room booking。up in the air 表示还没有定，即第二项。第四项把未定说成了取消。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Eda: Who has the puzzle box?
Finn: I left it with Jules.
Gus: Do we also need a timer?
Jules: Got the box. One piece is missing, though.
Eda: I found that piece under the mat. I will bring it.
Gus: That is a relief. We can finish the puzzle now.

options: The puzzle box Finn left with Jules
The timer requested by Gus
The piece found under the mat
The mat the piece was found under
items.why: 依据是 I found that piece under the mat. I will bring it。it 指这块拼图，即第三项。

items.stem: How does Gus feel in the final message?
options: Relieved that the puzzle can be completed
Annoyed that the box was lent to Jules
Uncertain about who owns the missing mat
Disappointed that the timer has disappeared
items.why: 依据是 That is a relief 和后面的理由 We can finish the puzzle now。第一项写出了宽慰和原因。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Anya: Does anyone have the portable speaker for the poetry recording?
Bo: I have it, but the battery is empty.
Cleo: What about the curtain for the background?
Anya: That is already hanging in the small room.
Bo: I will charge the speaker and bring it after lunch.
Cleo: lmk when it is ready. I will test the sound then.
Anya: Works for me. FYI, the microphone is already connected.

items.stem: What is already hanging in the small room?
options: The portable speaker
The recording microphone
The background curtain
The empty speaker battery
items.why: 依据是 What about the curtain for the background?。Anya 紧接着回答 That is already hanging，That 指幕布，即第三项。

items.stem: What does Cleo want Bo to do?
options: Notify Cleo when the speaker is ready
Move the curtain before recording
Test the sound after lunch
Reconnect the microphone after charging
items.why: lmk 即 let me know，when it is ready 指音箱充好电的时候，即第一项。第三项是 Cleo 自己要做的事。

items.stem: What arrangement does Anya accept with “Works for me”?
options: Bringing the speaker to the room before lunch
Hanging the curtain in the small room
Canceling the sound test that afternoon
Testing the sound once the speaker is ready
items.why: Works for me 回应的是前一条 I will test the sound then，then 指音箱准备好的时候，即第四项。

groups.label: Read the messages.
groups.text:
Dev: Who can collect the banner for the neighborhood debate?
Eli: I can. Is it at the sign maker's shop?
Fran: Do we need the wooden poles too?
Dev: Yes, those are in my shed. The banner is still at the shop.
Eli: omw there now. ETA 2:15.
Fran: I can fetch the poles while Eli gets the banner.
Dev: thx. lmk once both are in the hall.
Eli: BTW, the shop closes at three, so the timing works.

options: The banner still at the sign shop
The poles needed for the banner
The tools kept in Dev's shed
The signs made at the shop
items.why: 依据是 Do we need the wooden poles too?，those 回指复数的 wooden poles，即第二项。

items.stem: Where is Eli heading when sending “omw there now”?
options: To Dev's shed for the poles
To the hall where the debate is
To the sign maker's shop
To the hall to meet Dev
items.why: Dev 说 The banner is still at the shop，Eli 随后回 omw there now，there 指这家店，即第三项。去棚屋拿杆子的是 Fran。

options: The shop will close at that time.
The debate will begin at that time.
The poles must leave the shed then.
Eli expects to arrive at that time.
items.why: ETA 即 estimated time of arrival，紧跟在 omw there now 之后，表示 Eli 预计 2:15 到店，即第四项。关门时间是 three。
